newsitem.title: USA: Mallinckrodt, Hercules shares up on Tastemaker deal.
newsitem.headline: Mallinckrodt, Hercules shares up on Tastemaker deal.

text.p: Shares of Mallinckrodt Inc and Hercules Inc traded higher Wednesday morning after the two companies said they agreed to sell their 50-50 joint venture, Tastemaker, for a combined net value of $1.1 billion.
Tastemaker, which makes flavor compounds for the food and beverage industries, was sold to Roche Holding Ltd.
Mallinckrodt shares were up 7/8 at 41-3/8 and Hercules shares gained one at 47-3/8.
"We view it as a positive," A.G. Edwards analyst Gary Stevenson said of the Tastemaker deal.
Each company said it expects to realize about a $550 million net value from the transaction.
It was not immediately clear, however, if the net value is after taxes. Mallinckrodt spokesman Cole Lannum declined to specify the tax implications of the deal.
Mallinckrodt said it planned to use some of the proceeds to make incremental share repurchases of up to $250 million over the next 18 months, in addition to previous share buyback programs.
Hercules also said it expects to repurchase shares with its net cash proceeds.
